parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: EnableStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the domain name instance:

- enable: The GTM instance uses intelligent scheduling policies.

- disable: The intelligent scheduling policies of the GTM instance are unavailable.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: ScheduleDomainName
parameters.description: The GTM access domain name. The domain name is a combination of the host record (ScheduleHostname) and the root or subdomain (ScheduleZoneName).

parameters.name: ScheduleZoneName
parameters.description: The root domain, such as example.com, or subdomain, such as a.example.com, of the GTM access domain name. This is typically a domain name that is hosted in an authoritative zone in the Alibaba Cloud DNS console and belongs to the same account as the GTM instance.
